question: If the radius of sphere is decreased by 10 percent, then volume of sphere will be decreased by what percentage?
solution:
Given:

The radius of a sphere decrease by 10%.

Concept used:

The volume of the sphere = (4)/(3)pi {r³}

Explanation:

Volume = (4)/(3)pi {r³}

If the radius decreases by 10%

r × 90% = 9r/10

New volume = (4)/(3)pi× {(9r/10)³}

(∵ (4)/(3)pi is constant in both volumes so we calculated only the difference of radius basis)

Initial volume = r3

New volume = 729r3/1000

⇒ difference = r3 - 729r3/1000 = 271r3/1000

⇒ % changes = frac{{271r3/1000}}{{{r³}}} × 100

⇒ 27.1%

∴ The percent decrease in volume is 27.1%.
